dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Oh, you... You should've spent your salary on a good meal for yourself, or saved it, or something. To waste it on nothing is...

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: You are my closest kin, Master. According to the customs of mortals, I should demonstrate filial piety...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Cl— Err, Xianyun, Shenhe, what are you two talking about?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: It has been a while, indeed. Have you come all this way to visit one, then?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: O—Of course! Friendships need to be maintained from time to time, don't they?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Also... Paimon overheard you talking about a "good meal"... Hehe, is there something Paimon should know about that?

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: We were not discussing food, Paimon. Master was simply giving me guidance just now.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Many of the restaurant's younger customers have signed their parents up for the most popular group tour around. When I heard that their tours were designed specifically for seniors, I signed Master up as well.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: They're called "Seniorjoy Tours." Here, have a look at their pamphlet.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "O'er mountains tall and rivers wide, come see Liyue's wondrous sights"...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Accommodation at special guest suites, tasting authentic local delicacies, traveling in exclusive carriages...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow... Paimon kinda wants to try this out, too!

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Hmph. One had already traveled the length and breadth of this land long before the name "Liyue" even came to be. What sights could there possibly be that one has not yet beheld?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Also, a trip this luxurious couldn't have been cheap, right?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: *cough* It cost three months of her salary... and then some.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: *sigh* And you didn't think to confer with one before putting down the deposit either... Well, one has no choice but to go now, surely?

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: I would gladly spend my entire salary if it would make you happy, Master.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Oh, you silly... It is enough to have your devotion, Shenhe.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: But now that it's come to this, Shenhe, let us—

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Understood. I'll cancel the registration on your behalf, Master.

response.speaker: Xianyun & Paimon
response.text: Huh?

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: You're right, Master. I was too impulsive.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: The tour group manager was very convincing, but I'd rather listen to you, Master. I'll find him and cancel the registration as soon as possible.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: W—Wait, haven't you paid the deposit already?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: R—Right. Leaving the matter of getting the Mora back aside, it would be such a hassle...

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: It's no trouble. The manager promised me that the cost would be refundable. I will try my best to negotiate with words — and if an altercation occurs, that will only make things easier.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: What... You... *sigh* Forget it!

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Go, do what you must. The hour grows late — I shall return and cook for Shuyu!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh oh, what do we do? She's mad for sure... C'mon, we've gotta think of something!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, um...

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Hmm?

choices.text: Don't worry too much about it...

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Master's angry? Why would that be?

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: After that, is she still upset at how I spent my salary...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, no, she's definitely not mad at you! Don't blame yourself, okay?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But even though she said she didn't wanna go, she's really proud of you anyway! You should've seen her smile while we were chatting — any wider, and it would've split her face in two!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: She's probably just disappointed because she was looking forward to this trip, and it went up in smoke...

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: So if we proceed as originally planned, she'll be more than happy to go along with it. Is that what you mean?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #What do you think, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: An exclusive... Ooh, Paimon gets it! You're going to put together a travel itinerary tailored just for her, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #That sounds like a good plan. Nice one, {NICKNAME}! Oh, and what do you think, Shenhe?

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: You're the experienced one here. I trust your judgment.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Just leave it to us. {F#She}{M#He}'s the world-famous Traveler, after all, and Paimon's {F#her}{M#his} super-awesome guide!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We'll come up with a trip that's up to Xianyun's standards, for sure!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: An Adeptus Abroad: The Great Pleasure Excursion! Let's go!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup! Since she's seen all there is to see in Liyue already, let's take the opportunity to bring her to places further afield.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm. We're spoiled for choice, though. Where should we recommend she go first?

choices.text: Mondstadt, the City of Wind and Freedom.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Makes sense. That's where we started out, too, after all!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mondstadt City, Starsnatch Cliff, Windrise, and Sweet Madames... Gotta jot everything down...

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Is there anything I can help you with?

choices.text: There is something that only you can do...

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Understood. I will.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: #Thank you, Paimon. And thank you, {NICKNAME}.

choices.text: Give this Mondstadt Travel Guide to Xianyun.
A fine place to start a journey.
How about this? Let me design an exclusive, custom itinerary for Xianyun instead.
She won't stay angry for long, I'm sure...
